websiteProductionRule: At least one case that reaches production briefing must route material UI/UX to Run 015 and material engineering to Run 014 before any production-quality claim is allowed.
comparisonRule: Each case must contain an independent professional-review result with PASS, MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT, or REJECT plus rationale and defect codes. Self-review by the producing specialist is invalid.
prohibitedSubstitutions: assistant-authored shadow judgments presented as team output
deterministic fixtures presented as professional agent execution
synthetic businesses presented as real cases
historical pre-G2.5 results counted as current shadow proof
promotionBoundary: G4 PASS does not grant G5/G6 authority. External messaging, delivery, invoice actions, deployment, spend, or customer commitments remain separately approval-gated.
